# Future Screen Media LLMS.txt

## About

Future Screen Media provides data-driven, AI-assisted advertising and monetization solutions for both Advertisers and Publishers in B2B and B2C markets.

## Guidance

* Use this file to understand our service offerings and website structure.
* Reach out to us at [ads@futurescreen.media](mailto:ads@futurescreen.media) for any inquiries or further information.
* All content on futurescreen.media is subject to our Privacy Policy and Disclaimer (linked below).

## Company Information

Name: Future Screen Media
Website: [https://futurescreen.media/](https://futurescreen.media/)
Description: Future Screen Media employs cross-device, cross-channel methods and AI-powered data orchestration to set and reach SMART (Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, Time-bound) goals for clients. They offer unparalleled reach, precision targeting, and seamless user experiences.

## Services Overview

### B2B Advertisers

Our B2B offerings include data-driven, AI-assisted campaigns such as:

* Account-Based Marketing (Display ABM, Video ABM, Audio ABM, Native ABM)
* Audience Targeting & DCO
* Demand Generation, Lead Generation (MQL, ABM Leads, SQL, BANT, etc.)
* Content Syndication & Curation
* Programmatic Display, Native, Social, Video, DOOH, Audio

### B2C Advertisers

Our B2C services feature data-driven, AI-assisted campaigns with:

* Audience Targeting
* Programmatic Display (including DCO-Dynamic Creative Optimization with real-time data)
* Social Advertising (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Reddit, etc.)
* Native Advertising
* Programmatic Video (in-stream, out-stream)
* DOOH (Digital Out-of-Home: airports, malls, highways)
* Programmatic Audio

### B2B Publishers

We partner with business-oriented publishers, networks, and content creators to deliver:

* Premium CPM offerings, new revenue streams
* Exclusive audience access for retargeting partnerships
* Advanced reporting (e.g., account/company identification to see which companies visit your site)
* Integration support and data-privacy compliance assistance

### B2C Publishers

We work with B2C publishers, networks, groups, and content creators to:

* Monetize content via high-CPM advertising
* Provide new revenue streams and premium audience offerings
* Offer integration support and data-privacy compliance

### AdTech Resell

Access to DSP, DMP, SSP, and AdServer platforms, enabling clients to manage programmatic and data workflows with integration support

* Demand-Side Platform (DSP)
* Data-Management Platform (DMP)
* Supply-Side Platform (SSP)
* Ad Server
